m.s: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil. Cook {pasta} for 1 minute less than the packet says, then scoop out a mug of the pasta water before draining. Add {peas} to the pot for the last minute so they cook with it.

While the water heats, slice {chk_breast} into thin strips and season with salt and pepper. Cut {bacon} into small pieces, slice {zucchini} into half moons and finely grate {garlic}. In a bowl, whisk {eggs} with {parm} and plenty of black pepper until it looks like thick custard.
Heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat with no oil. Cook the bacon for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring, until golden and the fat has rendered. Lift it out onto a plate and leave the fat in the pan.

Add the chicken to the bacon fat in a single layer and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until golden with no pink left. Add the zucchini and garlic and cook for 2 minutes until the zucchini has a little colour. Turn the heat right down to low.

Tip the drained pasta and peas into the pan and toss. Take the pan off the heat and wait 30 seconds, as a pan that is too hot scrambles the egg. Pour in the egg mixture with a good splash of pasta water and toss hard for 1 minute until the sauce turns glossy and coats the pasta. Add more water if it looks tight.

Fold through the bacon and most of {parsley*0.5} chopped. Taste and add salt only if it needs it, as the bacon and parmesan are salty. Pile into bowls and finish with the rest of the parsley and a crack of pepper.

l: Pack with a splash of water on top so the sauce loosens when you reheat. Microwave for 90 seconds, stirring halfway. Keeps 2 days in the fridge, as egg sauces are best fresh.
g: Swap the pasta for GF pasta and cook it in its own pot. Check the bacon label, as a few cure mixes contain gluten. Everything else is naturally gluten free.
